nodes.label: NOXES horizontal logo + wordmark
nodes.rationale: Horizontal 450x128 logo on a transparent background. The signal mark (indigo #5B72F2 corner brackets framing a lime #D8F36A 'N' with a dot) sits on the left, paired with the 'NOXES' wordmark in bold white (#F4F5FB) Space Grotesk/Inter. Accessible title 'NOXES'. Purpose: primary full wordmark logo.

nodes.label: NOXES signal mark (N monogram + corner brackets)
nodes.rationale: The core NOXES brand symbol present in every asset: a lime-green stylized 'N' (two vertical strokes joined by a diagonal) with a small dot at the top-right, framed by four indigo rounded corner brackets forming a square. Serves as the identifying emblem across avatars and logos.

nodes.label: NOXES brand color palette
nodes.rationale: Shared brand colors: deep navy backgrounds (#101426, #1B2446), indigo/blue accents for the corner-frame (#5B72F2, #7184FF), lime/chartreuse (#D8F36A) for the N glyph and dot, and off-white (#F4F5FB) for the wordmark.

nodes.label: NOXES wordmark typography
nodes.rationale: The 'NOXES' wordmark is set in bold white Space Grotesk/Inter (Arial fallback), font-size 76, letter-spacing 1, used in the horizontal logos to pair with the signal mark.
